integrity: The proof reconstructs the source's spectral recursion and quantitative inequalities directly. Numerical checks are corroborative only and are not used to infer an infinite statement.
limitations: The round count is sufficient and deliberately conservative; no optimality or lower bound on the required number of rounds is claimed.
The code-level corollary fixes the target gap and round count before taking the blocklength sufficiently large; it does not give an explicit finite-blocklength threshold.
title: An explicit accumulation-round bound for approaching the CSS GV threshold
